objective: Improve controllable current138 members with stronger TabM, tree and sequence candidates under the unified late validation split.

current138_refresh.construction: replace the inner TabM component with TabM385 k32, preserve the old diversity tree and old two-seed GRU, then add 20 percent outer TabM385 k32

evidence.takeaway: reported GRU and transformer sequence models trail strong blends; reliable late validation and single-model gains matter
missingness masks and time intervals motivated the observed and age channels
